title: Measurement fidelity and external validation of automated breast DCE-MRI segmentation
zh_title: 乳腺DCE-MRI自动分割的测量保真度与外部验证
summary: 构建增强感知3D MedNeXt分割框架，以测量保真度为主要终点开展多队列与外部验证。
key_points: 内部测试与DUKE共521例配对病例
肿瘤体积中位误差9.7%，ICC 0.97
外部源留出分层Dice中位0.823
reason: 多队列外部验证并以测量保真度为主要终点，属重要档
abstract: Automated breast dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (DCE-MRI) segmentation could facilitate quantitative tumor measurement, but geometric overlap alone does not establish the fidelity of mask-derived measurements. We developed an enhancement-aware three-dimensional MedNeXt framework with gated skip fusion and boundary supervision and evaluated it in a retrospective multi-cohort design spanning locked internal testing, source-held-out assessment, retrospective external validation, and radiologist review. Measurement fidelity was the primary endpoint. Across 521 paired internal-test and DUKE cases, median errors were 9.7% for tumor volume, 1.8 mm for 3D maximum surface diameter, and 10.2% for operational enhancement-defined volume, with corresponding ICCs of 0.97, 0.80, and 0.97. Median Dice was 0.831 internally and 0.823 in the DUKE source-held-out stratum, and was 0.812 and 0.806 in the BC-MRI-SEG and public BreastDCEDL_AMBL retrospective external-validation cohorts, respectively, using the frozen checkpoint without external-label tuning. No major correction was required for 78 of 80 masks in the blinded two-reader review. In 276 paired response-analysis cases, AUROC was 0.732 with automatic geometry and 0.757 with expert geometry (difference, −0.025; 95% CI, −0.095 to 0.045); discrimination non-inferiority was not demonstrated. These findings support automated segmentation as a starting point for radiologist-supervised retrospective quantitative research within the evaluated cohorts, while distinguishing measurement fidelity from downstream predictive equivalence.
zh_abstract: 自动乳腺动态对比增强磁共振成像（DCE-MRI）分割可促进肿瘤定量测量，但仅几何重叠并不能确立掩膜衍生测量的保真度。我们开发了一个增强感知的三维 MedNeXt 框架，具有门控跳跃融合和边界监督，并在回顾性多队列设计中对其进行评估，涵盖锁定内部测试、源数据留出评估、回顾性外部验证和放射科医师审查。测量保真度是主要终点。在521例配对的内部测试和DUKE病例中，中位误差为肿瘤体积9.7%、三维最大表面直径1.8 mm、操作性增强定义体积10.2%，相应ICC分别为0.97、0.80和0.97。中位Dice在内部为0.831，在DUKE源数据留出层为0.823；在使用冻结检查点且未进行外部标签调优的情况下，在BC-MRI-SEG和公开BreastDCEDL_AMBL回顾性外部验证队列中分别为0.812和0.806。在盲法双读者审查中，80个掩膜中有78个无需重大修正。在276例配对反应分析病例中，自动几何的AUROC为0.732，专家几何为0.757（差异，−0.025；95% CI，−0.095至0.045）；未证明判别非劣效性。这些发现支持自动分割作为在所评估队列内由放射科医师监督的回顾性定量研究的起点，同时区分测量保真度与下游预测等效性。

title: Multicenter benchmarking of large language models for bladder cancer management recommendations from mpMRI reports
zh_title: 大模型生成膀胱癌mpMRI报告管理建议的多中心评测
summary: 按TRIPOD-LLM，用三家医院590份膀胱癌mpMRI报告回顾性评测9个大模型生成指南一致性建议的表现。
key_points: 三院590份报告，两种输入条件
21240条医生1-5分评分
输入语言与评分关联因模型而异
reason: 同行评审+三家医院外部验证，但为回顾性且以医生评分为终点，故取重要档下限
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can interpret radiology reports, but their ability to generate guideline-concordant recommendations from bladder cancer multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) reports remains uncertain. Following TRIPOD-LLM, we retrospectively evaluated nine API-accessed LLMs using 590 mpMRI reports from three hospitals under two input conditions: original Chinese reports and clinician-translated, quality-controlled English reports. Two physicians independently rated each model-generated recommendation on a 1–5 ordinal scale. We analyzed 21,240 ratings using patient-level random-intercept cumulative link mixed models, with paired Wilcoxon tests as secondary exploratory analyses. The association between input condition and physician rating differed across LLMs (likelihood-ratio chi-square = 683.05, df = 8, P < 0.001). Compared with original Chinese input, clinician-translated English input was associated with higher ratings for chatgpt-o3-pro (OR 2.79, 95% CI 2.29–3.41), deepseek-v4-flash (OR 1.46, 95% CI 1.19–1.81), claude-opus-4-7 (OR 3.07, 95% CI 2.47–3.82), and gpt-5.5 (OR 1.88, 95% CI 1.53–2.32), but with lower ratings for claude-sonnet-4-5 (OR 0.29, 95% CI 0.23–0.36; all Holm-adjusted P < 0.001). Four LLMs showed no clear input-condition difference. Center-specific contrasts also depended on input condition and were materially unchanged after adjustment for age, sex, pathological T stage, tumor grade, tumor number, and maximum lesion diameter. Inter-rater agreement was substantial (quadratic weighted kappa range, 0.621–0.743). Readability did not track physician-rated recommendation quality. These findings argue against clinician-translated English as a universal optimization strategy and support model-specific validation of input conditions before clinical deployment. LLM-generated recommendations from mpMRI reports are best positioned as clinician-supervised, imaging-based decision support rather than standalone treatment advice.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够解读放射学报告，但其从膀胱癌多参数MRI（mpMRI）报告生成符合指南建议的能力仍不确定。遵循TRIPOD-LLM，我们回顾性评估了九个通过API访问的LLMs，使用来自三家医院的590份mpMRI报告，在两种输入条件下：原始中文报告和经临床医生翻译、质量控制的英文报告。两名医生在1–5序数量表上独立对每个模型生成的建议进行评分。我们使用患者水平随机截距累积链接混合模型分析了21,240个评分，并以配对Wilcoxon检验作为次要探索性分析。输入条件与医生评分之间的关联在不同LLMs间存在差异（似然比卡方=683.05，df=8，P<0.001）。与原始中文输入相比，经临床医生翻译的英文输入与chatgpt-o3-pro（OR 2.79，95% CI 2.29–3.41）、deepseek-v4-flash（OR 1.46，95% CI 1.19–1.81）、claude-opus-4-7（OR 3.07，95% CI 2.47–3.82）和gpt-5.5（OR 1.88，95% CI 1.53–2.32）的更高评分相关，但与claude-sonnet-4-5的更低评分相关（OR 0.29，95% CI 0.23–0.36；所有Holm校正P<0.001）。四个LLMs未显示明确的输入条件差异。中心特异性对比也取决于输入条件，并且在调整年龄、性别、病理T分期、肿瘤分级、肿瘤数量和最大病灶直径后基本未改变。评分者间一致性相当高（二次加权kappa范围，0.621–0.743）。可读性并未与医生评定的建议质量相对应。这些发现反对将临床医生翻译的英文作为通用优化策略，并支持在临床部署前对输入条件进行模型特异性验证。来自mpMRI报告的LLM生成建议最适合定位为临床医生监督下的、基于影像的决策支持，而非独立的治疗建议。

title: Enhanced skin tone and blood estimation through AI-enabled upscaling of discrete reflectance spectra
zh_title: AI光谱上采样提升皮肤肤色与血液估计
summary: 该同行评审研究用全连接神经网络从稀疏漫反射光谱上采样，无创估计黑色素与血容量指标。
key_points: 在体模、猪皮与人体活体三类样本上验证算法
可变血液与黑色素体模中R²>0.90
猪皮黑色素估计与组织学密度评分r=0.95
reason: 多类样本验证含离体与在体，但样本规模未述，属值得一看档
abstract: Objective quantification of epidermal melanin content and dermal blood volume is crucial for equitable applications in dermatology and in the evaluation and engineering of optical devices, such as pulse oximeters, where variable amounts of melanin may introduce inaccuracies. Here, we demonstrate a method leveraging diffuse reflectance spectroscopy and a machine-learning framework using fully connected neural networks (FCNNs) to non-invasively estimate melanin and blood indices from sparse data through spectral upscaling. We validated the algorithm on custom phantoms, porcine skin, and in vivo human participants. In phantoms with variable blood and melanin (0–20%), the model achieved high accuracy (R2 > 0.90) to absolute concentrations. In porcine skin, estimated melanin strongly correlated with histology-derived density scores (Pearson r = 0.95). Across six regions of the human hand, the FCNN accurately estimated pigmentation from sparse wavelengths, even during hand-raise challenges that induce confounding blood volume changes. After upscaling, sparse-wavelength estimates strongly correlated with a model using over 450 wavelengths (Pearson r = 0.96), reducing data requirements ~ 150-fold without compromising accuracy. These findings highlight the importance of high-spectral information for disentangling melanin and blood contributions in reflectance spectra and the capacity of machine-learning to restore predictive performance from sparse inputs. These findings demonstrate that artificial-intelligence -driven spectral upscaling can enhance objective skin tone quantification in wearable optical devices.
zh_abstract: 对表皮黑色素含量和真皮血容量进行客观定量，对于皮肤病学中的公平应用以及光学设备（如脉搏血氧仪）的评估和工程化至关重要，因为不同量的黑色素可能引入不准确性。在此，我们展示一种方法，利用漫反射光谱（diffuse reflectance spectroscopy）和一种使用全连接神经网络（fully connected neural networks, FCNNs）的机器学习框架，通过光谱上采样（spectral upscaling）从稀疏数据中无创估计黑色素和血液指数。我们在定制体模（custom phantoms）、猪皮肤和在体人类参与者中验证了该算法。在血液和黑色素可变（0–20%）的体模中，模型对绝对浓度达到高准确度（R2 > 0.90）。在猪皮肤中，估计的黑色素与组织学衍生的密度评分强相关（Pearson r = 0.95）。在人手六个区域中，FCNN从稀疏波长准确估计色素沉着，即使在诱发混杂血容量变化的抬手挑战（hand-raise challenges）期间也是如此。上采样后，稀疏波长估计与使用超过450个波长的模型强相关（Pearson r = 0.96），在不损害准确性的情况下将数据需求减少约150倍。这些发现突出了高光谱信息在反射光谱中区分黑色素和血液贡献的重要性，以及机器学习从稀疏输入恢复预测性能的能力。这些发现表明，人工智能驱动（artificial-intelligence-driven）的光谱上采样可增强可穿戴光学设备中客观肤色的量化。

title: Learning health system frameworks and the integration of artificial intelligence and data science in United States health care: a scoping review
zh_title: 学习型健康系统框架与AI整合：范围综述
summary: 梳理美国54项学习型健康系统框架研究与30项AI/数据科学研究，考察AI如何嵌入此类持续学习体系。
key_points: 纳入54项框架研究，其中44%为概念性改造
另纳入30项AI与数据科学研究
归纳数据基础设施、治理等五大组件
reason: 范围综述，系统检索与双人筛选规范，但无外部验证与结局数据，属综述上限档
abstract: Learning Health Systems (LHSs) use routinely collected data to generate evidence that informs practice through continuous learning cycles. Artificial intelligence (AI) and data science may strengthen this model, but how LHS frameworks and AI applications relate remains unclear. We mapped LHS frameworks and their components and examined how AI and data science are integrated. Searches identified U.S.-based, English-language studies published January 2007–August 2025; two reviewers independently screened and extracted data, resolving disagreements by consensus. We included 54 framework studies (24 [44%] conceptual adaptations; 30 [56%] real-world implementations) and 30 AI/data science studies. Five components recurred across the frameworks: data infrastructure and interoperability, governance and stakeholder engagement, learning and improvement cycles, evidence generation and translation, and equity and ethics. Relative to framework studies, AI studies less often addressed governance and stakeholder engagement (17% vs 35%) or equity (13% vs 22%), emphasizing computational over organizational functions. Most AI studies (27/30) focused on the data-to-knowledge phase; only three extended to knowledge-to-practice, and none described practice-to-data feedback with post-deployment outcomes informing model updating. AI applications capture only part of the LHS vision, concentrating on knowledge generation with less attention to the organizational and feedback mechanisms needed to translate insights into practice and sustain learning.
zh_abstract: 学习型卫生系统（Learning Health Systems, LHSs）利用常规收集的数据生成证据，通过持续学习循环为实践提供信息。人工智能（AI）和数据科学可能强化这一模式，但LHS框架与AI应用如何关联仍不清楚。我们梳理了LHS框架及其组成部分，并考察AI和数据科学如何被整合。检索识别出2007年1月至2025年8月发表的、基于美国的英语研究；两名评审员独立筛选和提取数据，分歧通过共识解决。我们纳入54项框架研究（24项[44%]为概念性改编；30项[56%]为真实世界实施）和30项AI/数据科学研究。框架中反复出现五个组成部分：数据基础设施与互操作性、治理与利益相关者参与、学习与改进循环、证据生成与转化、公平与伦理。相对于框架研究，AI研究较少涉及治理与利益相关者参与（17% vs 35%）或公平（13% vs 22%），更强调计算功能而非组织功能。大多数AI研究（27/30）集中于数据到知识阶段；仅3项延伸到知识到实践，且无一项描述实践到数据的反馈，即利用部署后结局为模型更新提供信息。AI应用仅捕捉了LHS愿景的一部分，集中于知识生成，对将洞见转化为实践并维持学习所需的组织和反馈机制关注较少。

title: Artificial intelligence methods for HER2 status assessment: a systematic review and diagnostic meta-analysis.

also.source: PubMed · Journal of imaging informatics in medicine

zh_title: AI评估HER2状态的系统综述与诊断meta分析
summary: 该系统综述按PRISMA 2020评估AI判读HER2状态，纳入51项研究，其中14项进入诊断准确性合并分析。
key_points: 纳入51项研究，14项进入诊断meta分析
AI方法从传统机器学习逐步演进
采用QUADAS-2工具评价研究质量
reason: 系统综述+meta分析纳入研究较多，但仅合并诊断准确性、无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) is an important predictive and prognostic biomarker that guides targeted therapy, particularly in breast and gastric cancers. Conventional HER2 assessment using immunohistochemistry (IHC) and fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) is limited by inter-observer variability, heterogeneous expression, and diagnostic complexity. This systematic review and diagnostic meta-analysis followed the PRISMA 2020 guidelines to evaluate Artificial Intelligence-based HER2 assessment. Fifty-one studies were included in the qualitative synthesis and 14 in the diagnostic meta-analysis. Bibliometric analysis, methodological taxonomy, comparative evaluation, and pooled diagnostic performance were assessed, with study quality evaluated using QUADAS-2. AI methodologies have rapidly evolved from conventional machine learning and radiomics to deep learning, Vision Transformers, explainable AI, and multimodal frameworks, with histopathology and Magnetic Resonance Imaging. being the most frequently used modalities. Research activity increased markedly between 2023 and 2025. Pooled sensitivity was 87.8%, specificity was 83.5%, and Summary Receiver Operating Characteristic Area Under the Curve (SROC AUC) was 0.852 (95% CI: 0.801-0.881), indicating promising overall diagnostic performance. Deeks' funnel plot asymmetry test showed no significant evidence of publication bias (p = 0.14). However, heterogeneity warrants cautious interpretation of the pooled estimates. Heterogeneous datasets, limited external validation, and inconsistent evaluation methods remain important barriers to clinical implementation. Future research should emphasize multicenter prospective validation, explainable and multimodal AI, foundation models, federated learning, and evaluation in underexplored malignancies, including gallbladder cancer.
zh_abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] 人表皮生长因子受体2（HER2）是指导靶向治疗的重要预测和预后生物标志物，尤其在乳腺癌和胃癌中。使用免疫组织化学（IHC）和荧光原位杂交（FISH）的传统HER2评估受观察者间变异、表达异质性和诊断复杂性限制。本系统综述和诊断性meta分析遵循PRISMA 2020指南，以评估基于人工智能的HER2评估。51项研究纳入定性综合，14项纳入诊断性meta分析。评估了文献计量分析、方法学分类、比较评价和合并诊断性能，并使用QUADAS-2评价研究质量。AI方法已从传统机器学习和放射组学迅速发展到深度学习、Vision Transformers、可解释AI和多模态框架，其中组织病理学和磁共振成像（Magnetic Resonance Imaging）是最常用的模态。2023年至2025年间研究活动显著增加。合并敏感性为87.8%，特异性为83.5%，汇总受试者工作特征曲线下面积（SROC AUC）为0.852（95% CI：0.801-0.881），表明总体诊断性能有前景。Deeks漏斗图不对称性检验未显示显著的发表偏倚证据（p = 0.14）。然而，异质性要求对合并估计值进行谨慎解释。数据集异质、外部验证有限以及评价方法不一致仍是临床实施的重要障碍。未来研究应强调多中心前瞻性验证、可解释和多模态AI、基础模型、联邦学习，以及在包括胆囊癌在内的研究不足恶性肿瘤中的评估。

title: Reliability-Aware Clinical Relation Learning for Uncertainty-Robust Multi-Label Chest X-ray Classification
zh_title: 可靠性感知临床关系学习的胸片多标签分类
summary: 预印本提出ReCaRL图辅助框架，用可靠性加权与置信门控处理胸片多标签噪声标注，并做内外部区分评估。
key_points: 以训练标签关联构图，加权门控更新预测
用观测掩码处理不确定标注
与扁平、加权、图与层级惩罚基线对比
reason: 含外部区分评估且对比基线充分，但为预印本且细节待同行评审
abstract: Background: Automated multi-label classification of chest radiographs is complicated by overlapping imaging findings, noisy report-derived labels, and changes in disease co-occurrence across clinical settings. Existing clinical-hierarchy methods can encode label relationships, but a rigid hierarchy may conflate categorical membership with empirical association and propagate annotation errors. Methods: We investigated Reliability-Aware Clinical Relation Learning (ReCaRL), a graph-assisted framework for multi-label chest radiograph classification. An image encoder produces initial finding scores, while a graph constructed from training-label associations provides reliability-weighted, confidence-gated updates. Uncertain annotations are handled with observation masks. The evaluation compares flat, weighted, graph-based, and hierarchy-penalty baselines, with internal and external discrimination and calibration assessments. Results: In the internal evaluation, ReCaRL achieved macro AUROC 0.821 and macro AUPRC 0.437, compared with 0.812 and 0.423 for the masked/weighted baseline. Mean AUROC across five common findings was 0.865 versus 0.858. External testing yielded AUROC 0.799 and AUPRC 0.409. Post-hoc calibration reduced the internal Brier score from 0.113 to 0.102 and the external expected calibration error from 0.082 to 0.061, without changing AUROC or AUPRC. Conclusions: Reliability-aware graph propagation and confidence gating were associated with modest improvements in multi-label chest radiograph classification relative to the matched masked/weighted baseline. Post-hoc calibration improved probability reliability in the reported evaluations. The findings do not establish a benefit in prospective clinical decision-making.
zh_abstract: 【背景】胸部X线片的多标签自动分类因影像表现重叠、报告来源标签有噪声以及不同临床环境中疾病共现情况变化而变得复杂。现有临床层级方法可以编码标签关系，但僵化的层级可能将类别归属与经验性关联混为一谈，并传播标注错误。【方法】我们研究了可靠性感知临床关系学习（Reliability-Aware Clinical Relation Learning，ReCaRL），一种用于多标签胸片分类的图辅助框架。图像编码器生成初始发现评分，而由训练标签关联构建的图提供可靠性加权、置信度门控的更新。不确定标注通过观测掩码处理。评估比较了平坦、加权、基于图和层级惩罚的基线，并进行内部和外部判别与校准评估。【结果】在内部评估中，ReCaRL达到宏AUROC 0.821和宏AUPRC 0.437，而掩码/加权基线为0.812和0.423。五种常见发现的平均AUROC为0.865对0.858。外部测试得到AUROC 0.799和AUPRC 0.409。事后校准将内部Brier评分从0.113降至0.102，并将外部期望校准误差从0.082降至0.061，而未改变AUROC或AUPRC。【结论】相对于匹配的掩码/加权基线，可靠性感知图传播和置信度门控与多标签胸片分类的适度改善相关。事后校准在报告的评估中改善了概率可靠性。这些发现不能确立在前瞻性临床决策中的获益。

abstract: Racial and ethnic minority patients receive less pain treatment than non-Hispanic White patients, and large language models (LLMs) used as medical AI could reproduce that bias. Prior audits tested a few proprietary models, stated race explicitly and rarely measured the models' own response instability. In exploratory, non-preregistered analyses, Study 1 had four open-weight LLMs assess six acute-pain vignettes in every combination of four races and two sexes, with identity stated or cued only by a name (two names per group), comparing each identity with a White male reference on the same case and sampling seed. In Study 2, 24 configurations of 17 models, including OpenAI's GPT-4.1 mini and gpt-oss, Anthropic's Claude Haiku 4.5, Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash, Meta's Llama, DeepSeek and Qwen, with reasoning on and off and at two precisions, answered the same vignettes and the 50 clinician-written Q-Pain cases. In this single-prompt, JSON-constrained task, no difference survived correction in Study 1, none of 1,386 comparisons survived the false discovery rate in Study 2, and every pain-severity difference was equivalent to zero within one point on a 0-10 scale (within a quarter point for 237 of 238 Q-Pain comparisons). Opioid decisions were bounded less precisely (Study 1 could not exclude differences of about 20 percentage points), so they show no detected difference, not proof of none. The few differences surviving correction within a model favoured Black patients. Models differed far more from one another and across their own settings than between patients (the reference patient received the high opioid dose in 6% to 93% of responses), although serving software, provider and prompt format also differed. Fairness audits of clinical AI should use several names per group, pair comparisons on the seed, report the noise floor and test each deployed configuration.

abstract: [The Canadian journal of urology] Artificial Intelligence (AI) has the potential to transform clinical medicine by enhancing diagnostic precision, prognostic accuracy, and personalized decision making. In urological oncology, AI technologies are increasingly integrated across diagnostic, prognostic, and therapeutic pathways. This overview of systematic reviews aims to synthesise the current evidence on the performance and clinical utility of AI applications in urological malignancies. A systematic search was conducted of major bibliographic databases from 1974 to October 2024 to identify systematic reviews (SRs) evaluating AI-based models in urological cancers. We followed the Cochrane methodology of Overviews of Reviews. Outcomes of interest included diagnostic accuracy metrics (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve [AUC-ROC], sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy) and predictive performance for treatment-relatedoutcomes. A total of 67 SRs encompassing 1139 primary studies were included. RoB was assessed as low in 21 reviews, high in 41, and unclear in 5. Forty-five SRs evaluated AI in prostate cancer (PCa). AI models demonstrated high accuracy (88-93%) in distinguishing benign from malignant lesions, and outperformed human interpretation alone in predicting clinically significant PCa (AUC: 0.933 vs. AUC: 0.82-0.87). Performance in Gleason score classification was also very strong (AUC: 0.72-0.99, Accuracy: 70.8-93.0%). Sixteen SRs assessed AI in Renal carcinoma (RCa), reporting accurate subtype classification and tumor grade prediction, with some models exceeding 90% accuracy. Sixteen SRs focused on Bladder Cancer (BCa), showing improved detection of muscle-invasive disease and recurrence risk prediction compared with the conventional approach. Key limitations included heterogeneity in validation strategies, overlap of primary studies across reviews, and potential oversampling due to synthetic or augmented data. AI-based models consistently demonstrate improved diagnostic and predictive performance across urological malignancies and hold promise for enhancing clinical decision-making and patient outcomes. At present, AI tools should be regarded as decision-support systems that complement, rather than replace, clinical expertise. Future research should emphasize prospective validation, standardized outcome definitions, and evaluation of real-world clinical impact. Robust and harmonized evaluation frameworks are also essential to address challenges related to data quality

abstract: [Methodist DeBakey cardiovascular journal] Valvular heart disease (VHD) affects a substantial proportion of the population and remains a major cause of cardiovascular morbidity and mortality worldwide. Despite advances in surgical and transcatheter therapies, important challenges persist. VHD remains underdiagnosed, assessment of disease severity is often variable, and the optimal timing of intervention continues to evolve. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising tool across the spectrum of VHD care. AI-based electrocardiogram analysis can identify both existing and future VHD, while AI-guided point-of-care ultrasound extends screening to nonspecialist settings. Across multimodality imaging, machine learning (ML) and deep learning algorithms enable automated, reproducible assessment of VHD. In echocardiography, AI supports grading of disease severity across the main valvular lesions, including Doppler interpretation and automated report generation. AI-enhanced cardiac magnetic resonance facilitates automated assessment of ventricular remodeling and myocardial fibrosis, while AI-assisted cardiac computed tomography improves procedural planning for transcatheter interventions. In parallel, ML has identified distinct patient phenotypes in multiple valvular lesions with differing clinical trajectories and responses to intervention. This review summarizes current applications of AI in detection, multimodality imaging, and potential clinical decision support for VHD and discusses opportunities and challenges for integration into routine practice.

abstract: Background: Large language models (LLMs) are solely judged by their scores on biomedical benchmarks, yet these scores are rarely reproducible since the prompts, inference settings and model builds are seldom reported. We developed BenchmarkHub, an open-source platform for auditable evaluation of language and vision-language models for biomedical research. Methods: BenchmarkHub is a Python web application (Django 5.2, SQLite) released under the MIT licence and available at https://github.com/juanjuanignacio/benchmarkhub. The application can be accessed through a browser interface, a set of command-line tools and a REST API, so interactive exploration and scripted pipelines produce identical, comparable records. The platform samples questions with fixed seeds, runs models directly or as tool-using agents in a code sandbox, grades answers with deterministic rules and stores every prompt, reply and tool call. The interface provides a leaderboard to rank performance of the models, allowing model comparison without any preexisting programming knowledge. Findings: We used BenchmarkHub to evaluate 12 open-weight models in five experiments on 15 biomedical benchmarks (11 text, two multimodal and two computational biology) and two general benchmarks. The pooled accuracy ranged from 46.1% (95% CI 43.0-49.3) to 80.9% (78.3-83.3). Re-grading the responses with simple answer-extraction rules lowered a model's accuracy by up to 33.1 percentage points, leading to a reorder of the leaderboard. Published scores were found for 23 out of the 143 benchmark/model combinations tested. The accuracy measured by BenchmarkHub was lower than in the published results in 19 out of the 23 available comparisons. The effect of four prompting protocols (1: default prompt; 2: asking the model to answer the letter only; 3: chain-of-thought prompting; 4: three-shot prompting) changed MedQA accuracy by up to 11.3 points but was not significant after multiple-testing correction with 150 questions. We also tested the impact of ablation on benchmarking using the MMMU benchmark dataset. Removing images lowered the accuracy by 18.0 and 19.3 points respectively for the two strongest models. Finally, the accuracy of agentic benchmarks using a sandboxed interpreter increased on computational biology tasks by 36-63 points. abstract: Recent advancements in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLM) enhance X-ray report generation, but often neglect clinical context, overlook workflow integration, and lack explainability, which hinders clinical adoption due to interpretability and reliability concerns. This paper addresses the dual challenges of performance and expert explainability in automated X-ray report generation for clinical AI applications. Our proposed approach, TransXplainRRG, utilises an off-the-shelf Swin Transformer model along with a transformer-based text encoder that incorporates patient medical history to generate a radiology report. Further, we explore an expert-guided `inside-out' approach and extract only abnormal findings for radiology report refinement. Thus, this study bridges the gap between high-performance automation and interpretability critical for clinical practice by combining state-of-the-art transformer-based vision encoders, text encoders, and LLMs. TransXplainRRG is trained and tested on the large-scale MIMIC-CXR dataset and further evaluated on the unseen IU X-Ray dataset to demonstrate its generalizability and robustness. We employed the GREEN metric as a complementary measure of clinical consistency, achieving scores of 0.327 on MIMIC-CXR and 0.605 on IU X-Ray, both higher than those achieved by MAIRA-2 under the same evaluation setting. It also performed competitively across standard evaluation metrics, frequently matching or surpassing state-of-the-art models. Additionally, we introduce qualitative evaluation metrics developed from radiologists' viewpoints and conduct a preliminary radiologist evaluation on 100 generated reports to assess their clinical relevance. Quantitative and qualitative analyses further demonstrate the potential of our TransXplainRRG framework for reliable and explainable radiology report generation.
zh_abstract: 大型视觉-语言模型（Large Vision-Language Models, LVLM）的最新进展增强了X线报告生成，但常常忽视临床背景、忽略工作流程整合，并缺乏可解释性，这由于可解释性和可靠性问题而阻碍临床采用。本文针对临床AI应用中自动X线报告生成的双重挑战：性能与专家可解释性。我们提出的方法TransXplainRRG利用现成的Swin Transformer模型以及基于Transformer的文本编码器，该编码器整合患者病史以生成放射学报告。进一步，我们探索一种专家引导的“由内而外”（inside-out）方法，并仅提取异常表现用于放射学报告优化。因此，本研究通过结合最先进的基于Transformer的视觉编码器、文本编码器和LLMs，弥合了高性能自动化与临床实践所需可解释性之间的差距。TransXplainRRG在大规模MIMIC-CXR数据集上训练和测试，并在未见过的IU X-Ray数据集上进一步评估，以展示其泛化性和稳健性。我们采用GREEN指标作为临床一致性的补充度量，在MIMIC-CXR上获得0.327分，在IU X-Ray上获得0.605分，均高于MAIRA-2在相同评估设置下取得的分数。它在标准评估指标上也具有竞争力，经常匹配或超过最先进模型。此外，我们引入了从放射科医生视角开发的定性评估指标，并对100份生成报告进行初步放射科医生评估，以评估其临床相关性。定量和定性分析进一步证明了我们的TransXplainRRG框架在可靠且可解释的放射学报告生成方面的潜力。

abstract: Academic, psychosocial, financial, environmental, and interpersonal factors are widely recognized as important contributors to the overall wellbeing of students. This study aimed to identify factors associated with the psychological wellbeing of university undergraduates and compare the performance of machine learning models for binary and multiclass classification of wellbeing status using self-reported survey data from undergraduates at the University of Peradeniya, Sri Lanka. The findings may facilitate the early identification of students with lower wellbeing and inform targeted interventions to foster a healthier and more supportive academic environment. Cross-sectional questionnaire data from 2,913 undergraduates were analyzed to classify psychological wellbeing using overall happiness scores. Scores were grouped into binary (1-5 and 6-9) and multiclass (1-4, 5-6, and 7-9) categories. Data preprocessing included missing value imputation, one-hot encoding, and feature scaling where appropriate. Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), XGBoost (XGB), and Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) models were trained using repeated stratified 10-fold cross-validation and evaluated using macro F1-score, ROC-AUC, and classification reports. SHAP analysis was employed to interpret feature contributions and enhance model interpretability. XGB achieved the highest macro-F1 score (70.5%) for binary classification, with a test accuracy of 72.5%. The model correctly classified 63.6% and 80% of participants in the lower and higher psychological wellbeing groups, respectively. For multiclass classification, RF achieved the highest macro-F1 score (54.6%), with a test accuracy of 56.5%. The model correctly classified 48%, 57%, and 60% of participants in the lower, intermediate, and higher psychological wellbeing groups, respectively. SHAP analysis identified academic coping, health and wellbeing, financial circumstances, and interpersonal relationships as key predictors of psychological wellbeing across both models. These findings demonstrate the potential of machine learning to classify psychological wellbeing groups using self-reported data, supporting early identification of students at risk of poor wellbeing and informing targeted university-level mental health interventions.
zh_abstract: 学业、心理社会、经济、环境和人际因素被广泛认为是学生整体福祉的重要贡献因素。本研究旨在识别与大学本科生心理幸福感相关的因素，并比较机器学习模型在使用斯里兰卡佩拉德尼亚大学本科生自我报告调查数据对幸福感状态进行二分类和多分类时的性能。这些发现可能有助于早期识别幸福感较低的学生，并为有针对性的干预提供依据，以营造更健康、更具支持性的学术环境。分析来自2,913名本科生的横断面问卷数据，使用总体幸福感得分对心理幸福感进行分类。得分被分为二分类（1-5和6-9）和多分类（1-4、5-6和7-9）类别。数据预处理包括缺失值插补、独热编码，以及在适当时进行特征缩放。使用重复分层10折交叉验证训练支持向量机（SVM）、随机森林（RF）、XGBoost（XGB）和多层感知机（MLP）模型，并使用宏F1分数、ROC-AUC和分类报告进行评价。采用SHAP分析解释特征贡献并增强模型可解释性。XGB在二分类中取得最高宏F1分数（70.5%），测试准确率为72.5%。该模型分别正确分类了较低和较高心理幸福感组中63.6%和80%的参与者。对于多分类，RF取得最高宏F1分数（54.6%），测试准确率为56.5%。该模型分别正确分类了较低、中等和较高心理幸福感组中48%、57%和60%的参与者。SHAP分析识别出学业应对、健康与福祉、财务状况和人际关系是两种模型中心理幸福感的关键预测因素。这些发现证明了机器学习使用自我报告数据对心理幸福感组进行分类的潜力，支持早期识别有较差幸福感风险的学生，并为大学层面有针对性的心理健康干预提供信息。
